title: Policy-based protection host
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli protection_ passes; pdfxi protection apply validates and applies a real ProtectionPolicy, refuses expiry, optionally watermarks, protects with the policy mask and reopens fail-closed; SEC-011 moves to verified.
notes: Hosts ProtectionPolicy/apply_protection_policy composed with protect_document and the watermark renderer. Recipient labels are declarative; certificate key wrapping stays a provider boundary.
